statement: Verified chained transfer E1 -> E1' (Velu) -> J(C) (bielliptic pull-back) on one bielliptic curve per p in {211,419,821,1619}: counted genus-2 index calculus (full degree-1 base, relation phase) on J(C) costs 9.8x-42.9x counted Pollard rho on E1 (same r, n=1 per cell), ratio growing with p; rho on the isogenous curve and on the J(C) order-r subgroup stays within single-seed scatter of source rho. Boundary, not an improvement.
